description:
"Undone" is the first single from 'FIELDNOTES PT III' and is inspired by a book I read last year called ‘I May Be Wrong’ by Bjørn Natthiko Lindeblad- a Swedish business executive who swapped his career out to become a Buddhist monk in Thailand for 17 years. It's such a beautifully written book & it stuck with me for so long afterwards that I decided to write a song about it 💁🏾‍♀️
It's about letting go of control, ditching the facade that so many of us find ourselves latching on to, the question of what would happen if we simply left it all behind & started again.. it's possible! when I read that book it opened up so many possibilities & helped me to remember that I can start again whenever I choose! This song marks a new beginning for me, & simultaneously the closure of FIELDNOTES in a way, as I wrap up this chapter x
